messages.subject: For Vas Narasimhan | Global affairs, government relations and healthcare stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Novartis Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Dr. Vas Narasimhan, Chief Executive Officer.

Novartis' global medicines strategy depends on disciplined alignment across governments, regulators, health systems, manufacturing investments and communities. That stakeholder environment closely matches my current work.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, with senior institutional engagement in a complex emerging-market environment.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, global affairs and stakeholder execution might support Novartis' priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Novartis.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
